prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-realistic vertical red-studio fashion portrait of an original adult woman who does not resemble a celebrity. She has a straight blonde bob with full bangs, dark eyeliner, subtle freckle-like cheek dots, red lips, and a direct composed gaze. She wears a white satin bomber jacket over a buttoned black high-neck blouse, black tailored trousers, lace-inspired black cuffs, understated gold rings, and small dangling earrings. Pose her standing three-quarter view before a solid vibrant-red studio wall, holding a folded blank red program card in one hand. Use dramatic red rim light, deep sculpted shadows, controlled highlights on hair and satin, natural skin texture, shallow depth of field, and no smoke, cigarettes, text, logos, or watermarks.
